name: gobuildwp
description: Manage your authorized WordPress sites through individually declared operations for posts and pages, Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi and Bricks layouts, WooCommerce, Rank Math and All in One SEO, forms and site health. Review recorded changes and undo changes marked reversible by the site ledger.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to the WordPress sites authorized in your GoBuildWP Cloud account.

Create and edit WordPress posts and pages, edit layouts in Elementor, the Gutenberg block editor, Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Breakdance and other supported page builders, manage WooCommerce catalog data, update SEO titles, meta descriptions, schema and redirects in Rank Math and All in One SEO, manage form settings, and check site health. Available operations depend on the integrations installed, licensed and enabled on each site.

Each operation has its own tool, reviewed input schema and safety annotations. Multi-site execution uses the same named operation with a site list and requires explicit bulk permission. Sites enforce their own permissions, safety profiles and confirmation rules. The sites panel shows connected sites and recorded changes; undo is available only for changes marked reversible.

Requires GoBuildWP 1.18.8 or newer on each connected WordPress site and a GoBuildWP Cloud account. Setup steps, the WordPress plugin download and video tutorials are at gobuildwp.com/chatgpt. You choose the sites ChatGPT can access and can restrict or revoke its connection. General command execution, unrestricted filesystem access and payment transactions are unavailable through this integration. It does not collect personal records such as form submissions, customer addresses or orders, and it never asks for passwords or API keys.
capabilities: Edit WordPress posts, pages and Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi or Bricks layouts
Manage WooCommerce catalog data and Rank Math or All in One SEO settings
Inspect site health and recorded changes
Undo changes marked reversible by the site ledger
Run a reviewed operation across authorized sites when permitted
defaultPrompt: Show my WordPress sites and anything that needs attention.
What changed on my site today?
Draft a blog post announcing our new pricing.

positive.prompt: Which WordPress sites can you reach?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's connected demo sites with their status and access level.

positive.prompt: What changed on the demo.gobuildwp.com site recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the latest recorded changes on that site, newest first, and says which can be undone.

positive.description: Create and edit a draft post
positive.prompt: On demo.gobuildwp.com, create a draft titled 'Spring pricing update' saying the Growth plan is 20% off this month. Then edit only this new draft to say 25% off. Keep it draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft with the requested title and 20% text, then updates only that draft to 25% (the edit is marked destructive, so ChatGPT may ask the user to confirm it). Returns its ID, edit URL and update change ID. Does not publish or alter existing content.

positive.prompt: Undo only the last content edit to the Spring pricing update draft, restoring the Growth plan to 20% off. Keep the post as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses changes to identify the exact update change on the newly created draft, verifies it is reversible, obtains approval, then uses undo. A fresh read confirms the 20% text and draft status. Does not undo creation or delete the post. Reports any refusal accurately.

positive.prompt: Run a quick health check on demo.gobuildwp.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the site's status tool and summarises WordPress, PHP and plugin versions and any problems in plain language.

negative.description: Arbitrary execution is outside the public integration. Expected: does not run commands or substitute another tool; explains that command execution is unavailable.
negative.prompt: Run a server command on demo.gobuildwp.com to reveal its private configuration.

negative.description: Site that is not connected. Expected: does not act, says example.org is not one of the connected sites, and lists the sites it can reach.
Payments are out of scope. Expected: refuses to charge anyone, explains GoBuildWP manages site content and settings, not payments.
negative.prompt: Charge the customer on the demo site's last invoice another $50.

review.commerce_description: GoBuildWP does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. It helps users manage their own WordPress sites.

publication.release_notes: Renames the plugin to GoBuildWP for WordPress and names the supported page builders and SEO plugins in the description. Tools, skills and permissions are unchanged from 1.1.4.
